_note: Translations for /wissen/zitate (src/data/zitate.json). Emptied on purpose when the quotes changed from German to English originals: the old entries were machine translations of the German quotes and no longer matched (content-plan §1.4). New shape per help language: quotes[id] = {text, meaning, words?} (the quote translated, the easy-English explanation translated, and for languages the word data lacks, three word glosses). src/lib/zitateData.js and src/lib/zitateClient.js treat a missing entry as 'no translation' (the translation button and the translated explanation stay hidden; the word glosses fall back to the English definition).
